title: Collection, version 1
description: A typed list of like things a site shows in many places (DP12, DR21, DR22): talks, people, books, offices. Each item has an id unique in the collection; `item` is the JSON schema every item meets. Page documents and other collections point at an item with { "ref": "books/the-long-shore" } (the whole item) or { "ref": "books/the-long-shore", "field": "title" } (one value, a dotted path that follows references); a page whose route has `:id` and names the collection is each item's own page, and reads the item it shows with { "item": "title" }. Pure data: no markup, styles or code.

id.description: The collection's name: the first part of a reference (`books` in `books/the-long-shore`).

title.description: What the items are, for people ("Books").

idField.description: The item field that holds its id.

item.description: The JSON schema every item meets (its fields, types and which are required); the content check validates each item against it. A field that points at another collection's item holds a reference.

items.description: The items, in their default order.

ref.description: A reference to a collection's item, or to one value of it.

field.description: One value of the item, by a dotted path; a reference along the way is followed.

item.description: On an item's own page: one value of the item shown, by a dotted path that follows references.

binding.description: A list from a collection (DP13), in place of a hand-written list (a block's `items`), or as one entry of it (its items take that place). Fields are dotted paths that follow references.

where.description: Conditions every item meets, by field. A plain value is equality (a reference field compares by item id); else one test: in, has (a list field holds it), not, before, after (ISO dates; "today" is the reader's date). A value may be { "item": … } on an item's page.

sort.description: A field, or several, to sort by; `-` first for descending.

select.description: The fields the block needs, each from an item path: { "title": "name", "meta": "book.title" }. Without it, the whole item (with `href` when the collection has item pages).
